description:
When the soil on this ground crosses a planting threshold.

Returns the near-term forecast at planting depth, the date it crosses
within that horizon if it does, and when the crossing normally happens
here — so a grower knows both "plant this week?" and "how long have I got?".

Soil lags air by weeks and is the steadier signal. It is what decides
whether a clove or a seed should go in, not one warm afternoon.

band.description: 'planting' for 7-28 cm (~3-11 in, the default) or 'shallow' for 0-7 cm.

block.description: The ground to answer for: a block you have saved — its id, its name, one of its aliases, or any part of its name that only one block has (e.g. "Meadow" for "Lower Meadow"). If several match, the error lists them with their ids. Blocks may overlap; each answers for its own ground. Save one with block_save first; geometry travels once, not on every call.

direction.description: 'cooling' for an autumn window, 'warming' for a spring one.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

threshold.description: The soil temperature in °F that opens or closes the window. Garlic goes in below about 60.
